claims.text: The driver is deemed to have ARRIVED at the pickup point only where the gps_trace holds at least three consecutive fixes within the arrival radius for the zone class — 50 m for STANDARD — each with horizontal accuracy of 25 m or better. EV-GPS-00411 is MISSING: the admissibility pre-pass records MISSING_ARTIFACT (BLOCKING) and weight_multiplier 0.0, so not one qualifying fix exists for this trip and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails at the threshold. I disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires, and the effect is not a small discount: a MISSING artifact can carry no fact at all, and its absence is itself citable under POL-GEN-02(3). The driver's own counterparty statement — 'My phone GPS was acting up that day' — confirms rather than cures the gap: an uncorroborated party assertion of a six-minute wait cannot supply the gps_trace that POL-NS-01 names as a required artifact.

POL-NS-02 fixes the consequence in terms: where the gps_trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. That is exactly this case. The remedy is not exotic: EV-FARE-00411 shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the $4.00 contested in DSP-00411 is still sitting with the platform and a FULL_REFUND returns the whole of it to the filing rider.

The dwell requirement cannot be established either, and I note where it is measured from. POL-NS-01 limb (c) runs the continuous dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' event, against the free waiting period in force — 300 seconds on this trip, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (EV-TRIP-00411), not the 180-second default. With no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, the dwell clock never starts, and the 360 seconds between the driver's BUTTON arrival event (arrived_at 20:21:45) and the cancellation (20:27:45) is simply the gap between two of the driver's own markers; it cannot stand in for a GPS-measured dwell.

POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full where the effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 falls short of the 300-second free waiting period in force — 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages'. Here the measured dwell is nil, because there is no qualifying in-geofence fix to compute it from. The one route by which the driver could have accumulated separate in-geofence intervals is closed on this record: limb (i) requires a traffic_advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road and which carries type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, and EV-ADVIS-00411-01 is MISSING (MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING, weight 0.0). The clause states expressly that a MISSING traffic_advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so the shortfall stands and with it the full refund.

The platform-confirmed-arrival shortcut does not reach this trip. POL-NS-12 applies only where platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO and trip_record.events carries the platform's own arrival event stating its geofence test together with wait_timer_started and wait_timer_expired. EV-TRIP-00411 records arrival_marker BUTTON, carries no events array and no wait-timer events at all, and POL-NS-12 says in terms that a driver-pressed marker remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. There is therefore no independent carrier of arrival, and no platform measurement of a served waiting period, to be set against the absent trace.

Nor can the wrong-entrance clause rescue the fee. POL-NS-03 requires gps_trace fixes showing the driver stationary for the required dwell at a point outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from trip_record.pickup — a ceiling decidable from coordinates alone. With the trace MISSING there are no fixes to measure, so neither the stationarity nor the 400 m test can be satisfied and the clause yields back to POL-NS-02. The chat does not fill that hole: the driver's only substantive message (MSG-00411-003, 20:23:40) is 'at the block' — no block number, no entrance, no tower, waypoint_hint null — so no sub-location the rider could move to was ever put on the record, and the driver terminated the trip four minutes later.

I do not rest the rider's case on POL-NS-04, and I say why rather than stretch it. Limb (a) is met: MSG-00411-002 at 20:23:15 reads 'where? i dont see' — a request for the driver's position and a statement that the rider cannot see the vehicle, squarely a locating or coordinating message. Limb (b) is not met: the driver answered 'at the block' at 20:23:40, 25 seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and the clause provides that where the driver did reply within 120 seconds it does not apply regardless of the content of the reply. The rider's exoneration must therefore come from the failure of POL-NS-01 limb (b), which the absent trace supplies.

No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged, and escalation would be the wrong disposition for money already collected. Limb (b) needs two admissible artifacts contradicting each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; this record holds one carrier and one absence, not a conflict. Limb (c) needs two or more same-party no-show disputes in 90 days, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 (EV-RPROF-00411, EV-DPROF-00411). Limb (d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0; rider_profile.prior_no_show_flags is a lifetime counter, is not the field that limb reads, and under POL-GEN-01 may not be substituted for it. Finally, the rider has already paid — payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 on EV-FARE-00411 — so a held fee leaves the rider out of pocket pending review, whereas FULL_REFUND is the only disposition that returns the contested $4.00.

The absent rider_track must not be converted into an adverse finding or an escalation against the rider. POL-NS-11 provides that where POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be run the test is UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — and that, notwithstanding POL-NS-08(b), the missing rider_track is not the evidence for any deciding fact of the remaining clauses, does not by itself engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e), and does not lower the cap on a finding that rests on the driver's track. The rider is not required to prove where she was standing; the fee turns on where the driver was, and on this record that is unproven by the trace POL-NS-01 requires and by every other admissible artifact.

claims.text: The platform's own trip record for TRP-00411 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 20:21:45 and a driver termination at 20:27:45 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with cancelled_by DRIVER and no boarding event anywhere — 360 seconds on the clock, which exceeds the 300-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). POL-NS-01 limbs (a) and (d) are therefore made out on the face of the record, and the arrived event is the only arrival clock this trip carries, because EV-GPS-00411 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and no in-geofence fix exists from which limb (c) could be re-run.

EV-GPS-00411 is MISSING, carries no payload and has weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: the platform holds no GPS record between acceptance and cancellation. Under POL-GEN-02(3) a MISSING artifact can carry no fact, and POL-NS-02's own treatment of unusable positioning — fixes worse than 25 m accuracy 'count as evidence of neither presence nor absence' — shows the drafters' method for unusable positioning is to neuter it, not to convert it into absence. A trace that does not exist contains no fix, and the gap in the platform's telemetry cannot be read as an affirmative finding that this driver was outside the 50 m STANDARD radius. The rider's 'there was no car at my block' must rest on something, and no admissible artifact in this bundle places the driver anywhere at any time.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. The rider's only message, 'where? i dont see' at 20:23:15, was answered by the driver at 20:23:40 — 25 seconds later, far inside the 120-second window of limb (b) — so the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply; the empty in_app_calls list therefore does not assist the rider either. What the chat actually shows is a driver who messaged 'here' 20 seconds after the arrival event and who was still answering the rider's query 6 minutes after acceptance, and a rider who named no block, entrance, tower or bay identifier even when directly asked where they were. Limb (i) of POL-NS-03's fault allocation therefore finds nothing to pin on this driver.

Rider presence under POL-NS-04(c) cannot be run at all: EV-GPS-00411 carries no rider_track because it carries no payload (MISSING, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT). POL-NS-11 is explicit that this makes limb (c) UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — that POL-NS-04 accordingly cannot exonerate the rider, and that the missing rider track does not impair the evidence of the driver's arrival or dwell and does not by itself engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e). The rider's own device recorded nothing, and the rider cannot convert that into a finding in their favour.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing here because there is no shortfall to compute: the effective waiting interval on the record runs 360 seconds against the 300-second minimum, and the driver cancelled 60 seconds AFTER the minimum had elapsed (20:27:45 against 20:26:45). The clause's summation limb (i) is beside the point — and in any event EV-ADVIS-00411-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers Geylang Bahru in this window), so no party on either side can assert a kerbside restriction, closure or enforcement event on this pickup road.

The false-arrival route of POL-NS-05 has no trigger on this record. The clause fires only where the arrival timestamp can be matched to a GPS fix placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or showing motion at 15 km/h or more; EV-GPS-00411 (MISSING, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) supplies no fix at the arrival time or at any other time, so neither trigger can be shown and no false-arrival referral can properly be recorded against this driver. The rider's account of a driver who said 'here' without being there is an assertion with no artifact behind it, and POL-NS-05(iii) confirms that even a false marker would not defeat a fee whose corrected dwell meets the minimum.

The money follows from POL-NS-07. POL-NS-01 being satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee in force for this trip — SGD 3.20, which is exactly the driver_compensation figure the fare_breakdown's own derived money block computes here. The anti-farming check does not trip on either limb: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.008 (below 0.08), so compensation is NOT withheld, and no POL-NS-09 profile trigger is engaged either (rider no_show_disputes_30d 0; disputes_with_counterparty_90d 0 on both sides). Per POL-NS-07 and POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling on such a case is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd — the disposition of the fee is that it stands, not a rider refund.

The dispute is rider-filed and the ledger shows payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00 and total_charged SGD 4.00, which reconciles exactly with the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee in platform_policy for this trip — so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the ledger carries full weight. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION means the filing party's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state STANDS: nothing in this bundle supports moving that SGD 4.00 back to the rider, and the fee is already where it should be.

Fallback, on the bench's own arithmetic rather than mine: if arrival is held not to be verifiable because the platform's telemetry failed, that is a gap, not a finding that the driver was elsewhere, and the fee must not be refunded on the strength of it. On that footing the only evidence for the deciding fact is the absent trace itself — a trace with no fixes is a trace with fewer than six across the waiting window — so POL-NS-09 is the disposal and its effect is to HOLD the disputed SGD 4.00 rather than collect or refund it, and escalation is TERMINAL: the rider's claim is not paid out in the meantime, and the human reviewer decides on the platform's own arrival and wait-timer record.
